twoFactor.setupSubtitle: Your organization requires a second step when you sign in. It keeps your account safe even if your password leaks.
twoFactor.methodAppHint: Recommended. Works offline (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
twoFactor.methodEmailHint: A code is mailed to you each time you sign in.
twoFactor.passwordPrompt: Confirm with your password to continue.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key instead:
twoFactor.emailSent: We mailed you a 6-digit code. Enter it below.
twoFactor.codesBody: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone or mailbox. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.disableConfirm: Turn off two-factor authentication? Your other devices will be signed out.
